Not measured in legacy: no sim or harness tests class against class, and bots fire a separate, weaker model (enemyDmg in bursts, then a 4.5-5.1 s pause, shamble-game.js:2913 and :1627): about 6.2 DPS for a bot Conscript, 5.7 for a Warrior (plus a 48-damage lunge every 2.5 s within 3.2 m, shamble-game.js:2911) and 1.25 for a Peacekeeper if every shot hits, against player sustained DPS of about 9.7 (AMK), 51 (Bagpipe, all pellets) and 65 (Shabzon, before falloff). From the player numbers (body hits, no abilities): a Warrior kills a Conscript in 0.86 s against 10.5 s the other way; a Conscript beats a Peacekeeper only beyond the Bagpipe's 34 m; a Peacekeeper kills a Warrior in 0.85 s only if 11 of its 16 pellets land (else 3.45 s, against the Warrior's 1.30 s), so that side leans on the Riot Shield, which LOOP_V2 §4 locks until Tech 1. v2 needs one weapon model for bots and humans and sims of each matchup (3+ runs) before keeping these values.

Keep a pixel-ratio cap, but set it per quality tier (legacy caps at 2 with MSAA on; at ratio 2 a HiDPI laptop shades 4x the pixels of ratio 1, unmeasured against the VISION_V2 §4 Low target: a spike measures GPU frame time at ratio 1 and 2 on integrated graphics)
